But - two major problems prevent it from being awesome - you can’t upgrade your subscription! I signed up through Apple and now I want to bring on two other people to my “business” subscription. You can’t do it!!! I have to wait for my current subscription to expire, a month away, or start a new account and. Transfer everything which loses history and maybe some associations. Not much of a business subscription if you can’t more people!!!! The other really really bad thing is app startup time. I open my phone for a morning meeting, go to notion to start AI notes and it just sits there… I’m on WiFi, and the app takes so long to load up it misses the first part of the meeting - often the MOST critical part!  These two things take the app from great to something I can’t rely on. And if I can’t rely on it, then I have to have something else that I can rely on. Really unfortunate. I do have a problem with it, though: I can't do as much on mobile as I can on desktop. I know desktop is inherently more powerful, but Notion is just so limiting on mobile. I would love it if you could improve the quality of the mobile version. For example, with a simple table, I cannot add a cell, row, or column on mobile; I have to do that on desktop.

That's only one example. There are so many things entirely possible that I'd love for mobile to do, but it just can't.
